name: East of the Colossal Wyrm Remains
accessNote: Varlamore savannah east of the Colossal Wyrm Remains; several safespots and free of Karamja poison hazards, so no antipoison is needed. A quetzal landing site at Colossal Wyrm Remains gives a quick shortcut to an Auburnvale bank and a prayer altar at The Teomat; nearest fairy ring is AJP.
